commit fa437d8d3c38210bf4f2034058912748364462ef (HEAD -> master)
Author:     Werner Lemberg <wl@gnu.org>
AuthorDate: Tue Jan 31 23:06:38 2017 +0100
Commit:     Werner Lemberg <wl@gnu.org>
CommitDate: Tue Jan 31 23:06:38 2017 +0100

    [cff] Provide metrics variation service interface (#50196).

    Only now I've got an OTF with an HVAR table for testing...

    The code in `ftmm.c' uses `FT_FACE_LOOKUP_SERVICE' to get the
    metrics variations interface.  However, this didn't work with
    `FT_FACE_FIND_GLOBAL_SERVICE' used in `sfnt_init_face'.

    * src/cff/cffdrivr.c: Include FT_SERVICE_METRICS_VARIATIONS_H.
    (cff_hadvance_adjust, cff_metrics_adjust): Wrapper functions for
    metric service functions from the `truetype' module.
    (cff_service_metrics_variations): New service.
    (cff_services): Updated.

    * src/cff/cffpic.h (CFF_SERVICE_METRICS_VAR_GET): New macro.
    [FT_CONFIG_OPTION_PIC]: Synchronize code.

    * src/sfnt/sfobjs.c (sfnt_init_face): Replace call to
    FT_FACE_FIND_GLOBAL_SERVICE with `ft_module_get_service' to always
    load the service from the `truetype' module.
53b9769f0 (origin/bytecode_shuffle) [truetype] Consolidate the context setup.
1820f950e [truetype] Modify the graphics state management.
bec95d033 * src/truetype/ttinterp.c: Relocate the context functions.
5a07f41d0 (origin/master, origin/HEAD) [sfnt] `FT_Load_Sfnt_Table` can now also load a font's table directory.
3aeabbf87 [gzip] Update sources to zlib 1.13.1.
202297eb5 * src/base/ftobjs.c (FT_Load_Glyph): Loosen auto-hinting constraints.
d629c8bff Update `CHANGES` file.
f7fba637a [gxvar] Optimize out more bounds checking.
c06251408 * src/truetype/ttgload.c (load_truetype_glyph): Use `IS_DEFAULT_INSTANCE`.
f64c7db2f [gxvar] Set `doblend` to `FALSE` if at default location.
fa412cf5c [mm/gxvar] Always detect default instance and use optimized codepath.
deef6d2a3 Typo.
31d05d089 * src/truetype/ttinterp.c (TT_Load_Context): Clean up.
c6abd1e40 [autofit] Fix integer overflow.
e07e56c7f [gxvar] Speed up handling of deltas in `ItemVariationStore`. (3/3)
86ab14e03 [gxvar] Speed up handling of deltas in `ItemVariationStore`. (2/3)
fe6854ba5 [gxvar] Speed up handling of deltas in `ItemVariationStore`. (1/3)

b8444f2fb [gxvar] Move scalar computation into its own function.
57a873045 [autofit] Make the accent database work for more glyphs (again).
